method.cache: --cache explicitly enables buffered I/O; source preparation warms source pages; no OS cache flush
method.claims: local conventional-delta diagnostic only; no WAN ranking, novelty, energy, FIPS, or production-security claim
method.clock: fixture generation, source replacement, directory setup, result logging and cleanup excluded; spawn, wait, stats parsing, exact bytes, target ObjectId, file+parent sync and output-buffer teardown included
method.cpu: RUSAGE_SELF plus RUSAGE_CHILDREN deltas after synchronous child wait; local aggregate, not separate endpoint CPU
method.limits: synthetic 1MiB base, prefix target 1MiB+1; at most 90 selected tasks and 360 rows; fixed absolute executable and generated owned paths
method.order: per case, alternate delta/whole_file first with trial parity; odd trial counts differ by one
method.seed: each arm independently protocol-transfers the base into an empty destination before its update; no destination copy credited
method.sync: file sync_all plus destination parent sync_all after exact validation; OS sync boundary, not power-loss proof
method.timeout: rsync --timeout=30 is an I/O timeout, not hard CPU preemption
method.transport: local rsync process transport; reported protocol counters are not captured physical wire bytes

rsync.version:
openrsync: protocol version 29
rsync version 2.6.9 compatible
